Penn State · B.S. Computer Science · Aug 2025 – Dec 2028 · West Chester, PA

::: {.lede}
I'm a Computer Science undergraduate at **Penn State**, graduating December 2028.
:::

Most of what I do sits between software engineering and statistics. I build systematic
trading strategies, though more of the hours go into the infrastructure — the part that
keeps a strategy running unattended without quietly turning into a different strategy
than the one I tested.

I founded **Weaver Capital LP** in January 2026 and run a multi-strategy systematic
portfolio there, across futures and equities on intraday, swing, and macro horizons.
Two of the strategies are live: [Rime](rime.html), a daily ETF regime allocator, and
[Fifth Sanctuary](fifth-sanctuary.html), an intraday gold volatility-expansion system.
The execution infrastructure is mine too — Python and C#, with automated strategy
synchronization, enforced risk limits, and sub-second order handling — along with the
portfolio optimization pipelines that allocate across uncorrelated sleeves.

Since August 2026 I've also been an undergraduate researcher in the **Locomotion in
Biology and Robotics (LiBR) Lab** under Dr. Baxi Chong, working on gait optimization in
unconventional robot morphologies. It's a long way from futures, which is part of why I
wanted it; the common thread is controlling a system you can only partially observe.

Before college I founded [FTC #16468 Green Lemons Robotics](robotics.html) and ran it
for six seasons, writing the autonomous control software. We finished #1 OPR globally
among more than 8,000 teams at the 2024 World Championships.

## What I'm looking for

Summer 2027 internships in software engineering, quantitative development, or
quantitative research. I'm most useful where the modeling and the systems work are the
same problem: research infrastructure, backtesting and simulation frameworks, execution
systems, data pipelines that have to be right.
